position.purpose: Machine-readable chronology and evidence-boundary record for CP8 / ASIN-HHC / Holbrook.
position.non_accusation_boundary: Similarity to another project is treated as conceptual convergence unless direct derivation is independently demonstrated.

constitutional_rules: No mechanism may silently convert uncertainty into authority.

cryptographic_anchors.boundary: A matching digest establishes byte integrity relative to the referenced artifact; it does not independently establish authorship, correctness, safety, reproduction, or patent scope.

self_reported_anchors.boundary: Status, ownership, priority, claims, and scope require verification from official records and qualified legal counsel.

evidence_classes.GIT_VERIFIED: A public commit establishes that specified repository content existed by the commit timestamp.
evidence_classes.HASH_VERIFIED: A digest recomputed from the referenced artifact matches the recorded value.
evidence_classes.LOCALLY_EXECUTED: The project preserves a local execution result or receipt; this is not independent reproduction.
evidence_classes.SOURCE_ARCHIVE: Earlier project material is preserved, but internal dates and retrospective statements require separate corroboration.
evidence_classes.SELF_REPORTED_ANCHOR: A claim supplied by the project steward but not independently verified by this record.
evidence_classes.INDEPENDENTLY_REPRODUCED: An unaffiliated party has reproduced the result and published sufficient methods and receipts.

collaboration_boundary.ai_agents: Assistant-generated artifact producers; no default independent authority.
